history.body: Hi, my partner and I are comparing homes around Seberang Jaya. I work from home a few days a week and need a quiet separate room for video calls. Could Pearl’s three-bedroom layout work well for us? I also saw a dated starting-price reference of around RM302k, which may be within our range.

The three-bedroom layout could give you the option of using one bedroom as a dedicated work room, separate from the open-plan living and dining area. I can’t confirm how quiet or sound-isolated it would be for calls, so the approved plan and the room itself are worth checking. The roughly RM302k figure you saw is a dated reference, not a confirmed current price; I’ll verify the latest pricing. If useful, a viewing could also help you judge whether the room separation works for you.

A separate room could solve the work-call problem better than taking over the dining table. I’d need to see how it sits relative to the living area, and I understand the plan won’t tell me how soundproof it is. Could you show me the floor plan? I may want to view it if the layout looks workable.

A separate bedroom could keep your work calls off the dining table. The layout information I have confirms three bedrooms and an open-plan living and dining area, but it doesn’t show exactly where the bedroom sits in relation to them. I’ll request the approved floor plan so you can assess that; if the layout looks workable, we can then explore a viewing.
